text_block_list.text:
And that sees the end of my third year
with Super
Creek.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The motherly Umamusume and
greenhorn trainer
are now known as a
top-class duo.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: One day, at tryouts...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So many people are approaching me... I
have no
idea what I should do.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Who should I choose? Hmm, decisions,

decisions...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: What's the matter?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Oh! You're Супер Крик!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Could you offer me some advice for
picking a
Тренер? I'm having trouble
deciding.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Goodness me. Have you been
approached by a
ton of candidates?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all sorts. From those who look like
they'd
train me well to others who seem
to be very
knowledgeable.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
But I don't know which trainer would be
the best
for my future.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Hmm... For your future, huh?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Well, the answer's simple! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Choose someone who you think you can
do your
absolute best for.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: What? I'm the one who has to put in the effort? Isn't the trainer supposed to put in the effort for me?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I believe that it's more
important to
prioritize giving over
taking.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: It's a necessary part of racing—and you do want to continue racing together in the long run, right?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Th-that never even crossed my mind...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! ♪ Nothing, just a bit of
chitchat.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I'll see you around! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you very much!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Aww, I'm so jealous of Супер Крик for
getting
approached by such a gifted
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
She mentioned giving more than taking,
but there
aren't any trainers out there
who give as much as
hers.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did you hear that? You're a gifted
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I, too, was once a totally average trainer.

text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I bet you were always
gifted.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You just needed a little time to realize
what those
gifts were...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
Did you honestly think I was gifted from the
very beginning?

text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's hard to say...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't matter whether you're
gifted or just
average.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I can still depend on you to stay with me
to the
very end. Right?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
For me, my desire to do things for you
will never
change.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
If anything, that desire might even be
greater
than when we first met.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Fine, I'll allow you to keep spoiling me.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! I was right about there
only
being one way to choose a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You choose someone you want to do
things for...
because Umamusume are
givers. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Another year, another new cohort of
Umamusume
starting at Tracen
Academy, ready to be
nurtured.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Супер Крик is probably the only
Umamusume
who nurtures her trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
